summary: Probably the first wife of Gaetano di Marino of Guardia Lombardi and mother of Concetta, not of John's ancestor Grazia; not in his direct line.
bio:
Maria d'Ambrosio lived and died at Guardia Lombardi, Avellino, Campania, Italy, a daughter of Giuseppe D'Ambrosio (1761–1841) and Maddalena Gialanella (1764–1824). She was probably the first wife of Gaetano di Marino, John's 4th-great-grandfather, who afterwards married Caterina di Leo. Her daughter Concetta di Marino married Giuseppe Petriello, son of Carmine Petriello and Maria Marra, on 26 December 1855.

Family records once showed Maria as the mother of Gaetano's daughter Grazia, John's ancestor, but Grazia's death record names her mother as Caterina di Leo. Maria and her D'Ambrosio and Gialanella forebears are therefore not in John's direct line.
